license.notes: Zoo 1.12.0. The convenience store's reach-in cooler wall, from the walker's store references (docs/SET_DRESSING_REFERENCES.md 2026-09-15: 'a full back wall of glass-door reach-in coolers (drinks, milk jugs, juice), lit from inside, with a sign band above') and 'we also want glowing fridge lights' (2026-09-28). A run of glass doors on black frames with handles, steel shelves behind, product panels, a fluorescent tube down every mullion, and a sign band a pair of doors per section. The glow is emission, not light: products, tubes and sign band are ONE backlit material on ONE image (M_Cooler_<art>_Face, Lux's power cut takes it). Three submissions whatever the length: painted steel (colour in the Wear vertex colour), glass, glow. A slot deeper than the ~0.9 m cabinet gets the walk-in's plain body behind it. Every drink is an invented brand from core/brands.py. Collision is the slot's box.
